show.description: Jagadish, the 50-year-old widowed owner of Aira Airlines, disguises himself as a ground crew worker and books a first-class ticket to secretly test his airline's service. When an air hostess judges his appearance and humiliates him by forcing him to the economy cabin, kind-hearted air hostess Nethra steps forward and defends him with grace and dignity. Now Jagadish must silently navigate the chaos, protect his identity, and teach them a lesson
show.description_secondary: Jagadish, the 50-year-old widowed owner of Aira Airlines, disguises himself as a ground crew worker and books a first-class ticket to secretly test his airline's service. When a snobbish air hostess judges his appearance and humiliates him by forcing him to the economy cabin, kind-hearted air hostess Nethra steps forward and defends him with grace and dignity. Now Jagadish must silently navigate the chaos, protect his identity, and decide the fate of those who failed and those who truly represent the heart of Aira Airlines.
